Title: Poetic Justice
Writer: Leah Nanako Winkler, Matthew K. Begbie, Anju Andre-Bergmann
Actors: Carrie Preston, Wendell Pierce, Braeden De La Garza
Plot: After a donor's death shakes New York City art scene, Elsbeth questions the motives of the victim's friend Gary, the founder of a poetry journal; Elsbeth runs into her old friend Marissa Gold, who is working for a mayoral candidate.
